posts.title: Wizard Nebula from home
posts.description: After the Rocky Mountain Star Stare , I was eager to try setting up the new ED80 rig at home. The first subject I was able to shoot was the Wizard Nebula . Here is the result of two nights’ worth of data, shown here in the Foraxx palette . Read more...
